Tooltip_HARMONIE_MA_Bullbar: A welded steel bullbar for the front end. Genuinely reacts to real front-end impacts (hitting zombies, objects, anything that damages the vehicle's front end) by wearing its own condition down instead of staying pristine -- it does not reduce the damage the vehicle itself takes, just visibly takes real hits so it isn't purely decorative.
Tooltip_HARMONIE_MA_WindowArmorPlate: A welded steel plate reinforcement for a windshield or door window. Built tougher than the glass it covers, so it degrades slowly on its own -- it does not restore or repair the window underneath.
Tooltip_HARMONIE_MA_CargoRack: A welded steel frame for the truck bed. Once installed, it opens up as its own secure storage container (30 capacity), separate from the vehicle's normal trunk space.
Tooltip_HARMONIE_MA_PerformanceExhaustKi: A performance exhaust and tuning kit for the engine bay. Once installed, raises engine power by up to 15% -- the bonus scales down as the kit's own condition wears down, reaching 0% extra power if it breaks completely.
